Pattern.Intent: Single canonical script binds the unified format pipeline. Agents, humans, CI, pre-commit run the same name.
Pattern.Why: Read-only and repair commands are separate. Repair bricks declare target-forwarding prefixes; required `fix` supplies whole-project roots while phase verification supplies exact targets. Static checking rejects only obvious broad operands and shell indirection. `typecheck` is its own script — type-aware concerns are routed to TS, not lint.
